if $args[0] = 'activity_value' or $args[0] = 'activity_sign' or $args[0] = 'activity_compatible' or $args[0] = 'activity_known':
 local $j9av_role = $args[1]
 result = 0
 ! Existing saved display routines still call activity_compatible.
 if $args[0] = 'activity_compatible': result = 1 & exit
 if $args[0] = 'activity_known':
  if dyneval('result = ' + $j9av_role + "['jo9_work_ethic_known']") = 1 or dyneval('result = ' + $j9av_role + "['passion_comfort_revealed']") = 2: result = 1
  exit
 end
 local j9av_work = dyneval('result = ' + $j9av_role + "['jo9_work_ethic']")
 local j9av_comfort = dyneval('result = ' + $j9av_role + "['passion_comfort']")
 local j9av_sign = 0
 if j9av_work > 0 or j9av_comfort < 0:
  j9av_sign = 1
 elseif j9av_work < 0 or j9av_comfort > 0:
  j9av_sign = -1
 end
 if $args[0] = 'activity_sign' or $args[2] = 'jo9_work_ethic': result = j9av_sign
 if $args[0] = 'activity_value' and $args[2] = 'passion_comfort': result = -j9av_sign
 exit
end
if $args[0] = 'activity_repair':
 local $j9av_role = $args[1]
 local j9av_sign = func('jo9_traits', 'activity_sign', $j9av_role)
 result = 0
 dynamic $replace({
  if j9avactor['jo9_work_ethic'] ! args[0] or j9avactor['passion_comfort'] ! -args[0]:
   j9avactor['jo9_work_ethic'] = args[0]
   j9avactor['passion_comfort'] = -args[0]
   result = 1
  end
 }, 'j9avactor', $j9av_role), j9av_sign
 exit
end
if $args[0] = 'activity_load':
 local j9av_i, $j9av_role, $j9av_roles
 copyarr '$j9av_roles', '$all_slave_characters'
 $j9av_roles[] = 'stock'
 $j9av_roles[] = 'selected'
 $j9av_roles[] = 'saved_stock'
 $j9av_roles[] = 'snk_parked_slave'
 for j9av_i = 0 to arrsize('$j9av_roles') - 1:
  $j9av_role = $j9av_roles[j9av_i]
  if dyneval('result = ' + $j9av_role + '_state') > CONST_INT['no_slave']:
   gs 'jo9_traits', 'activity_repair', $j9av_role
  end
 end
 exit
end
